freeze_rule: Commit before any new coupled-state evaluation, solve, component value or comparison. Retain all rows and failures; do not tune thresholds after residuals.
scope: Research-only coupled event assignment for a declared truncated model; numerical qualification is separate from physical clock/arrival qualification.

model.coordinates: TT-compatible nominal WGS84 input X_TT at fixed TT; X=X_TT/F_G. r=x_station(t)-x_E(t) at one TCB event; output r_TDB=F_B*r. No station proper time is solved.
model.scaling: F_B=1-L_B, F_G=1-L_G. v_TCB=v_TDB; W and vector potential are invariant; a_TCB=F_B*a_TDB; spatial potential gradients and total dW/dt_TCB multiply by F_B; jerk_TCB=F_B^2*jerk_TDB.
model.spatial: H(r)=r+[v(v dot r)/2+W*r+r(a dot r)-a(r dot r)/2]/c^2=X; four fixed-point updates.
model.coefficients: Newtonian ten-body point masses. d=x_body-x_E, u=v_body-v_E, mu=GM_TDB: W=sum(mu/|d|), a_TDB=sum(mu*d/|d|^3), vectorW=sum(mu*v_body/|d|), gradVectorW_TCB=F_B*sum(mu*v_body outer d/|d|^3), dotW_TCB=-F_B*sum(mu*(d dot u)/|d|^3), jerk_TCB=F_B^2*sum(mu*(u/|d|^3-3*d*(d dot u)/|d|^5)).
model.local_time: B_i=-(v dot v)*v_i/2+4*vectorW_i-3*v_i*W; B_ij=2*gradVectorW_ij-v_i*a_j+delta_ij*dotW/2; C=-|r|^2*(jerk dot r)/10. Q=gradW-a=0 in the declared Newtonian monopole coefficient model.
model.clock: D(TDB)=TT_geocentre(TDB)-TDB from raw DE440t time segment. S=F_G*[v dot r/c^2-(B dot r+r^T B_ij r+C)/c^4]. delta=TDB-TT_site solves delta+D(TT_site+delta)-S(TT_site,TT_site+delta)=0.
model.derivation: Subtract geocentre from IAU B1.3 TCG relation at the same TCB event, multiply by F_G, then use the existing integrated D. Geocentric integral/normalization is neither re-integrated nor added twice.
model.argument: At each iteration, requested ET=exact decimal TT seconds + delta. Evaluate all external fields at float(requested ET); inject that actual ET into Skyfield orientation. Retain exact binary64 ET and quantization error. This defines a quantized numerical oracle; a small residual is not a continuous-root or physical-error certificate.
model.station: Skyfield WGS84 at fixed TT using frozen EOP/leaps, no observed dX,dY correction; default approximate TDB-TT disabled. Nominal input scale assumption is not surveyed ITRF evidence.
model.omissions: Higher PN terms; nonmonopole forces, omitted bodies/spins, physical station/EOP/ephemeris errors, and self-consistency of Newtonian acceleration with DE440's full dynamical model are unbounded. Q=0 is the coefficient-model assumption, not a measured exact Earth relation.

offline_candidate: Independent NumPy coefficient/matrix implementation and fixed-point solver consume checked-in state samples keyed by actual binary64 ET. Missing ET fails explicitly; no interpolation, hidden reuse or approximate clock. Analytic synthetic readers test solver behavior beyond the archived trace.
diagnostics: scaled leading and each local c4 term
